claims.claim: Google's Gemini Decision 1 model scores up to 1,000 multimodal questions in one 150-250 ms pass at $0.10 per million input tokens with zero output cost.
claims.episode_span: Google's Gemini Decision 1 scores up to 1,000 multimodal questions in one 150-250 ms pass at $0.10 per million input tokens with zero output cost.
claims.supporting_quote: It supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question. It's priced the same as the GPT-6 Luna decision model: 10 cents per million input tokens, and output is free.

claims.claim: AlphaGenome 2 predicts regulatory activity and variant effects in specific cell types from a 1 Mb window plus a 256-dimensional cell-state embedding.
claims.episode_span: AlphaGenome 2 is a conditional DNA sequence model that predicts regulatory activity and variant effects in specific cell types from a 1 Mb window plus a 256-dimensional cell-state embedding.
claims.supporting_quote: It predicts the impact of DNA variants in different specific cell types - unlocking crucial information for understanding complex diseases.

claims.claim: The AWS emulator covers 438 API models across more than 200 services and was written entirely by autonomous AI agents.
claims.episode_span: AWS released an official local emulator written entirely by autonomous AI agents that covers 438 API models across more than 200 services.
claims.supporting_quote: Finally, an official emulator from AWS to run tests against a local clone of their many different services without having to provision a paid API key to do so. It's written in Rust by a huge swarm of agents - 29,684 commits in the first three weeks of the project.
